article.headline: Winkel’s 12 lead North Dakota over Detroit Mercy 77-67
article.description: — Luke Winkel scored 12 points as North Dakota beat Detroit Mercy 77-67 on Tuesday.
article.linkText: Winkel’s 12 lead North Dakota over Detroit Mercy 77-67

categories.description: North Dakota Fighting Hawks @ Detroit Mercy Titans

event.description: North Dakota Fighting Hawks @ Detroit Mercy Titans

keywords: North Dakota Fighting Hawks @ Detroit Mercy Titans
article.story: CANCUN, Mexico -- — Luke Winkel scored 12 points as North Dakota beat Detroit Mercy 77-67 on Tuesday. Winkel had seven assists for the Fightin’ Hawks (4-3). Tyler Wagner scored 11 points while going 4 of 11 (3 for 9 from 3-point range). Zack Parks shot 4 for 8, including 1 for 4 from beyond the arc to finish with 11 points. Ayden Carter led the way for the Titans (0-6) with 16 points and 13 rebounds. Lance Stone added 15 points for Detroit Mercy. Tyler Spratt finished with 12 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
